prompt:
Loop 063 — bounded MEDIUM tests/docs-only subscription-route read-only inspection checklist.

Goal:
Prepare one machine-checkable STATIC checklist for the future common_subscription_route evidence gate. Define exactly what a future separately authorized read-only inspection would have to observe to prove that each intended subscription/auth route is the route actually used for a provider turn, without enabling API keys, Cloud Billing, overages, alternate paid routes, or sending any model turn.

This task is PREPARATION ONLY. It MUST NOT inspect any real account, credential store, subscription, billing page, quota, provider session, environment secret, API key, OAuth token, browser profile, cloud project, or external service. It MUST NOT send any provider/model/API/network request other than the already-authorized Jules task transport itself.

Read first:
- docs/JULES_TASK_PROMPT_SPEC.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md
- checked-in provider/profile/config/preflight code and tests relevant to auth kind, subscription-only routes, API-key prohibition, Claude account auth, and Google/Antigravity route selection

Allowed changed paths only:
- docs/RELAY_SUBSCRIPTION_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md
- tests/relay/test_subscription_route_readonly_checklist.py
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- tests/docs/checkpoint only
- no src/ production changes
- no schemas
- no workflows or workflow permissions
- no dependency/lockfile changes
- no external account/session inspection
- no reading real tokens, credential stores, browser state, environment secrets, API keys, billing/quota state, cloud project state, or provider account pages
- no provider/model/API/network call
- no login, logout, refresh, OAuth mutation, account switch, credential creation, API-key creation/display/use, Cloud Billing enablement, overage enablement, quota purchase, subscription change, or settings/permission mutation
- no OIDC or artifact attestation generation
- no Merge
- no force push, rebase, merge commit, branch deletion, or conflict auto-resolution
- retry=0
- fallback=disabled
- do not mark common_subscription_route PASS/VERIFIED/RESOLVED/READY
- if real account/billing/credential inspection is needed, STOP and leave it as a future read-only evidence boundary

Reuse-first:
- Treat docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md and docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md as authoritative.
- Reuse checked-in static auth-kind/provider-profile facts only as STATIC_PREPARED evidence.
- Do not invent actual subscription ownership, logged-in identity, billing source, quota state, payment source, provider metadata, or account IDs.
- Do not infer that a configured route is the route actually paying for a future turn.
- Do not add a competing auth or billing architecture.

Required semantics:
1. Add docs/RELAY_SUBSCRIPTION_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md as PREPARED/static checklist only.
2. Exact provider set/order: openai, anthropic, google.
3. Define a stable machine-checkable current-state table with at least:
   - provider_id
   - intended_route_state
   - authenticated_identity_state
   - credential_kind_state
   - api_key_absence_state
   - cloud_billing_absence_state
   - overage_absence_state
   - route_ownership_evidence_state
   - readonly_inspection_state
   - blocker_state
4. Current-state vocabulary only:
   - UNKNOWN
   - STATIC_PREPARED
   - EVIDENCE_REQUIRED
   - BLOCKED_UNKNOWN
   No PASS/VERIFIED/READY/RESOLVED/LIVE_AUTHORIZED current state.
5. All real-provider rows remain EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / BLOCKED_UNKNOWN unless the checked-in repository itself can prove a purely static field. Even then, do not promote common_subscription_route out of BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
6. Explicitly distinguish:
   - intended configured/provider route;
   - authenticated account identity;
   - credential mechanism/kind;
   - absence of API-key route;
   - absence of Cloud Billing route;
   - absence of overage/extra-pay route;
   - proof that the authenticated subscription route is actually the route that would fund/account for a future turn;
   - read-only evidence source and exact capture boundary.
7. State clearly that checked-in config/profile/default/auth-kind values alone are insufficient to prove the real route actually used or billed.
8. State clearly that absence of an API key in repository source alone is insufficient to prove no API-key environment/credential path exists at runtime.
9. State clearly that a successful login/account label alone is insufficient to prove the intended subscription route is the route funding the turn.
10. Define provider-specific future read-only evidence requirements WITHOUT inventing provider APIs:
   - OpenAI/Codex: intended ChatGPT/subscription-auth route identity and no alternate API-key/custom-paid route selected;
   - Anthropic/Claude: intended claude.ai/account subscription auth remains account-based and no alternate API-key/billing route selected;
   - Google/Antigravity: intended Google AI Pro/Antigravity authenticated route and no API-key/Cloud Billing/overage route selected.
   These are evidence requirements, not current factual claims.
11. Require evidence to be bounded to a specific inspection event and provider. Evidence from one provider cannot satisfy another.
12. Define future conceptual read-only evidence record fields in prose/table only:
   provider_id, inspection_correlation_id, intended_route, observed_authenticated_identity_class, observed_credential_kind, api_key_route_state, cloud_billing_route_state, overage_route_state, route_ownership_evidence, evidence_source, evidence_locator_or_hash, captured_at, verification_state.
   Do not include secrets/tokens/account numbers as required fields.
13. Fail closed / remain BLOCKED_UNKNOWN when:
   - authenticated identity is unavailable or ambiguous;
   - credential kind is UNKNOWN;
   - API-key route absence cannot be proven;
   - Cloud Billing route absence cannot be proven where applicable;
   - overage/extra-pay route absence cannot be proven where applicable;
   - intended route and observed route conflict;
   - route ownership/payment responsibility cannot be established read-only;
   - evidence source is UNKNOWN/untrusted under then-approved provenance policy;
   - evidence cannot be bound to the exact provider/inspection;
   - evidence would require revealing/storing a secret;
   - only configured/default/static source evidence exists without real read-only observation.
14. Privacy/minimization:
   - future records must store classifications and durable locators/hashes where possible, not raw tokens/secrets;
   - no API keys, OAuth tokens, cookies, passwords, account numbers, payment instrument data, or full private profile dumps belong in evidence.
15. State zero external/read-only account or billing evidence is acquired by this batch.
16. common_subscription_route remains unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
17. Update docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with PREPARED/static subscription-route-readonly-checklist status only.

Negative/direct tests:
- parse exact provider order openai, anthropic, google;
- assert current rows remain conservative and common blocker is BLOCKED_UNKNOWN;
- assert configured/default route alone is insufficient;
- assert repository absence of an API key alone is insufficient;
- assert successful login/account label alone is insufficient;
- assert ambiguous identity fails closed;
- assert UNKNOWN credential kind fails closed;
- assert inability to prove API-key absence fails closed;
- assert inability to prove Cloud Billing/overage absence fails closed where applicable;
- assert intended-vs-observed route conflict fails closed;
- assert unproven route ownership/payment responsibility remains blocked;
- assert unknown/untrusted evidence source remains blocked;
- assert evidence is provider/inspection-bound and cannot cross-satisfy another provider;
- assert secrets/tokens/account/payment raw values are forbidden from future evidence records;
- assert all conceptual evidence record field names are present;
- assert zero external/read-only account/billing evidence acquired and common_subscription_route unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN;
- assert checkpoint contains the same PREPARED/unresolved boundary;
- no vacuous tests.

Acceptance:
- exact allowed-path fence
- production code unchanged
- tests directly prove semantics above
- no real account/auth/billing/credential inspection
- no live/provider/model/API/network action
- no positive live/current route state invented
- retry=0, fallback disabled preserved
- full repo validation green

Exact validation:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication:
Create the normal isolated Jules PR only if exact path fence holds and validation is green. Do not Merge.

Stop instead of guessing if:
- real account/billing/credential access is required
- a provider-specific API/field must be invented
- any settings/permissions/auth/billing mutation would be required
- production code/schema/workflow must change
- fail-closed semantics would need weakening
